A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.

★ IDENTIFIED: Giant Water Lily. Huge floating leaves, night-blooming flowers. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Giant Water Lily too.

By evening diana is thoroughly, educationally sick. "NOT food," they announce to the fire, pale. "My body told me so." The lesson is learned the hard way — and now the whole village knows it.
